transcriber_notes: First block (年次 rows): 10 rows (昭和5-14年) as printed; row labels printed '昭和 5 …', '〃 6 …' (ditto marks), written as full '昭和N年'. Each row's 總數 reconciles exactly with the sum of the 13 provinces (all 10 rows, diff 0). 昭和14 row equals the 總額 row of the 種類別 block.

Second block (種類別): 142 rows read (frames p0073-p0075, printed pp. 126-131). Table is printed across each spread: left page 總數 + 京畿道-全羅南道, right page 慶尙北道-咸鏡北道; matched by the row numbers/braces repeated at the right edge. Rows with two lines (quantity and 円) are written as two rows, label suffixed with the unit in parentheses: (瓩) = the small glyph printed beside 生絲 etc. (read as 瓩, kilograms), (米), (反), (打), (本), (円). Row numbers/brace labels '(1)', '1' etc. are kept in the label; they restart under each sub-group, so labels are not unique — row order is the key. Labels printed in running text, e.g. '8 織色木綿色木綿', as read.

Hierarchy (as printed, indentation): 總額 > 紡織工業 > (1)製絲 / (2)紡績 / (3)撚絲 ; then (4)織物 > 1 綿織物 / 2 絹織物 / 3 絹綿交織物 / 4 麻織物及麻交織物 / 5 毛織物及毛交織物 / 6 人造絹織物, each with 1 廣幅物 / 2 小幅物 / (3 特殊物) and numbered items below. The printed '(4)' label's first character is in heavy type and hard to read; read as (4)織物 (the 綿織物 etc. are sub-items of (4)), and '織物' read from the heavy type of the first-character glyph.

Every row: 總數 vs sum of 13 provinces re-added in python: ALL rows reconcile except one: row '6 白木綿 (米)' under 4 織物 > 1 綿織物 > 1 廣幅物: 總數 34,500 but provinces sum to 36,500 (diff -2,000); cells re-read at close crop, as printed. Its 円 row reconciles.

Where a total spans the gutter: left and right pages are joined; no subtotal-to-item checks beyond the province sums were done except spot checks (野蠶絲 瓩 4,730 = 4,703+8+19; 綿絲 瓩/円; 絹紡絲; 撚絲 (3) = 44,850+58,400+1,724,460).

Cell '4 生皮苧' etc. and other dash cells: printed dash '—'; a few dashes are printed doubled ('--') or with specks, all written '—'.
Unreadable cells: none.
